memories.content: Specify the order and recipients for reporting serious discomfort during the study.
Field staff rely on a pre-defined contact sequence when serious discomfort is reported.
Establish criteria for halting the use of a design alternative if recurring severe errors appear during formative evaluation.
Do not include a design alternative halted for safety reasons in subsequent evaluation iterations without modification.
Even in controlled environments, delayed prototype recovery procedures increase session interruption time and alter data collection conditions for the same task.
Mark unverified schedule assumptions as such.
Mark unverified recruitment assumptions as such.
Mark unverified technical assumptions as such.
Trace back the resources required for each core prototype feature and field research procedure.
Operations reviewers judge feasibility by examining the personnel required for each procedure.
Operations reviewers judge feasibility by examining the equipment required for each procedure.
Operations reviewers judge feasibility by examining the time required for each procedure.
Document separately the commitments and confirmation status of field partners required for recruitment, installation, and operational support.
Designate a responsible party for software updates, equipment inspections, and user support during the deployment period.
The user's deployment readiness can be assessed only when dependencies on external services and field personnel are visible.
Field schedules and assigned personnel may change due to operational factors beyond the researcher’s control.

analysis.overview: The frames cover separate operational domains. The reference focuses on participant-safety escalation, unsafe-design controls, and prototype recovery effects; the compared frame focuses on assumption transparency, feasibility dependencies, partner commitments, deployment ownership, and operational uncertainty. No contradiction or shared operational policy is established.

relations.reason: Both memories express complementary parts of one reference-only escalation protocol: defining the contact order and relying on it in the field.
relations.summary: Serious discomfort is handled through a predefined reporting sequence with specified recipients.

relations.reason: This is an independently useful reference-only rule for deciding when safety-related evaluation must stop.
relations.summary: Formative evaluation should use established criteria to halt alternatives that produce recurring severe errors.

relations.reason: This reference-only rule governs reentry after a safety halt, independently of the criteria used to initiate the halt.
relations.summary: An alternative halted for safety reasons must be modified before entering later evaluation iterations.

relations.reason: This is a separate reference-only observation about recovery timing and evaluation validity.
relations.summary: Delayed prototype recovery increases interruptions and changes data-collection conditions even in controlled settings.

relations.reason: The memories split one compared-only transparency policy across three assumption categories.
relations.summary: Unverified schedule, recruitment, and technical assumptions should be explicitly labeled.

relations.reason: This is a compared-only requirement for resource traceability across both prototype and research work.
relations.summary: Required resources should be traceable for every core prototype feature and field research procedure.

relations.reason: The memories divide one compared-only feasibility assessment into three required resource dimensions.
relations.summary: Procedure feasibility is reviewed through its personnel, equipment, and time requirements.

relations.reason: This is an independent compared-only documentation policy concerning external partner commitments.
relations.summary: Field-partner commitments and confirmation status should be documented separately for recruitment, installation, and operational support.

relations.reason: This is an independent compared-only accountability requirement for deployment-period support.
relations.summary: Responsible parties should be designated for updates, inspections, and user support during deployment.

relations.reason: This is an independent compared-only prerequisite for assessing readiness.
relations.summary: Deployment readiness assessment requires visible dependencies on external services and field personnel.

relations.reason: This is an independent compared-only statement of operational uncertainty affecting field execution.
relations.summary: Operational factors outside researcher control may change field schedules and assigned personnel.

reports.compared_only: The compared frame addresses labeling uncertain assumptions, tracing and evaluating required resources, documenting partner commitments, assigning deployment support ownership, exposing readiness dependencies, and recognizing schedule and staffing volatility.
reports.reference_only: The reference addresses serious-discomfort escalation, criteria and safeguards for halting unsafe alternatives, and the effect of delayed prototype recovery on sessions and data collection.
